hypothesisVerdict.outcome: C — tokenization improved, no generation gain; hypothesis REJECTED at generation level
reasoning: tokenization-level half confirmed: tokens/CJK 2.685→2.404→2.244, single-token chars 5.3%→10.0%→17.1% (monotone, reproducible)
training fit improves monotonically: final loss 0.1226→0.1120→0.1074
generation target unchanged: temp-0.8 valid UTF-8 identical zh 0.5 / en 0.5 / mixed 0.0 across A/B/C; greedy invalid 0.40→0.80→0.60 (worse); rollout flat; Level 3 for all
tripling single-token rate moved generation by exactly zero -> merge granularity is not the Level-4 blocker
failure mode is rollout compounding of 3-byte CJK triplets (en stays valid, zh/mixed collapse by step ~20), a model-capacity/rollout-reliability problem, not tokenization

nextBottleneck: rollout-time byte-triplet integrity: the 1.1M-param/4-layer model cannot keep a valid multi-byte UTF-8 sequence across 24 autoregressive steps; not data, tokenizer granularity, or training fit.
